events.title: Mazeppa (Tschaikowski)
events.title_en: Mazeppa – Tchaikovsky opera (Russian, English surtitles)
events.description: Tchaikovsky's dramatic opera about the Cossack hetman Mazeppa; last performances this season. In Russian with German and English surtitles.

events.title: The Fairy-Queen – Barock+
events.description: Richard Egarr directs the Frankfurt Radio Symphony from the harpsichord with soprano Rowan Pierce: Purcell's Fairy-Queen suite, Handel's Concerto grosso op. 6/7 and Cipriani Potter's G-minor Symphony.

events.title: Yulianna Avdeeva, Klavier – Appassionata
events.title_en: Piano recital: Yulianna Avdeeva
events.description: Chopin Competition winner Yulianna Avdeeva's first solo recital at the Alte Oper: Bach's Italian Concerto, Beethoven's 'Appassionata' and Ravel's La Valse.

events.title: Metropolis Wiesbaden
events.title_en: Metropolis Wiesbaden – live theatre-film with orchestra
events.description: A live theatre-film event inspired by Fritz Lang's 'Metropolis': the Hessisches Staatsorchester plays Gottfried Huppertz's monumental film score while video shot live around Wiesbaden is projected on stage.

events.title: Warten auf heute (Schönberg / Frank Martin)
events.title_en: Waiting for Today – Schoenberg & Frank Martin double bill (English surtitles)
events.description: Double bill of 20th-century music theatre by Arnold Schoenberg and Frank Martin. German with German and English surtitles; 17 Oct is the last performance of the season.

events.title: La traviata (Verdi)
events.title_en: La traviata – opera by Verdi
events.description: Verdi's beloved tragedy of the courtesan Violetta, performed by the Wiesbaden opera ensemble and Hessisches Staatsorchester.

events.title: 2. Kammerkonzert
events.title_en: 2nd Chamber Concert
events.description: Sunday-morning chamber music in the theatre's grand foyer with members of the Hessisches Staatsorchester (cello: Johann Ludwig, tuba: Roland Vanecek).

events.title: Lohengrin (Wagner) – Premiere
events.title_en: Lohengrin – Wagner opera, new production
events.description: New production of Wagner's romantic opera of the mysterious swan knight, directed by Erik Raskopf and conducted by Gabriel Venzago. Sung in German with surtitles.

events.title: Behind the Scenes – English pre-concert talk + BBC Philharmonic
events.venue: Alte Oper Frankfurt – Albert Mangelsdorff Foyer
events.description: The Alte Oper's new evening for Frankfurt's international communities: an English-language talk (with the British Chamber of Commerce and BBC Philharmonic musicians), the concert, then a chill-out with live jazz.

events.title: Lachrymae – Kammermusik
events.title_en: Lachrymae – chamber music for flute, viola & harp
events.description: Chamber music for flute, viola and harp by members of the hr-Sinfonieorchester: Dowland, Britten's Lachrymae, Debussy's Sonata, Piazzolla's Histoire du Tango.

events.title: Silent Echo (Hessisches Staatsballett)
events.title_en: Silent Echo – contemporary ballet triple bill
events.description: Hessisches Staatsballett in choreographies by Imre & Marne van Opstal, Marco Goecke and Fran Díaz. Wordless, so ideal if your German is still a work in progress.

events.title: BBC Philharmonic Orchestra
events.description: Anja Bihlmaier conducts the BBC Philharmonic with cellist Pablo Ferrández: Ligeti's Concert Românesc, Tchaikovsky's Rococo Variations and Beethoven's Symphony No. 7.

events.title: Zaide (Mozart)
events.title_en: Zaide – Mozart singspiel fragment
events.description: Mozart's unfinished singspiel, completed with excerpts from his 'Thamos' music, in the atmospheric former tram depot. Sung in German with German surtitles.

events.title: Die Zauberflöte (Mozart)
events.title_en: The Magic Flute – Mozart
events.description: Mozart's magical opera, a perfect first opera night. 15 Nov is a family performance.

events.title: In der Strafkolonie (Philip Glass)
events.title_en: In the Penal Colony – chamber opera by Philip Glass
events.description: Philip Glass's chamber opera after Kafka, staged in the stone hall of the Landesmuseum. Intro 30 minutes before.

events.title: Hoffmanns Erzählungen (Offenbach)
events.title_en: The Tales of Hoffmann – opera by Offenbach (new production)
events.description: New staging of Offenbach's fantastical opera by award-winning young director Dennis Krauß, set in a fairground where the poet Hoffmann loses himself in his own stories. Premiere 10 Oct; intro 45 min before.

events.title: Ensemble Modern
events.description: Frankfurt's world-renowned contemporary-music ensemble in its Alte Oper series.

events.title: Falstaff (Verdi)
events.title_en: Falstaff – Verdi's comic opera
events.description: Revival of Verdi's final opera, a sparkling comedy about Shakespeare's roguish knight.

events.title: Ottone (Händel) – Premiere
events.title_en: Ottone – Handel opera, new production (Italian, English surtitles)
events.description: Handel's rarely staged baroque intrigue about the marriage of Emperor Otto II and Theophanu, conducted by Václav Luks. Sung in Italian with German and English surtitles.

events.title: Alte Oper Nights – Urban Vibe Festival
events.description: New three-night festival across the whole building: genre-crossing sets by Cello Octet Amsterdam, Kinan Azmeh, Repercussion, Martynas Levickis and more, talks, and a silent film with live music. One ticket, pick freely.

events.title: 2. Sinfoniekonzert: Russische Emigranten
events.title_en: 2nd Symphony Concert: Russian Émigrés
events.description: The Hessisches Staatsorchester under Leo McFall plays Stravinsky's two suites for small orchestra, Prokofiev's Piano Concerto No. 2 (soloist Tom Borrow) and Rachmaninoff's Symphony No. 2. Pre-concert talk at 18:45.

events.title: Tancredi (Rossini)
events.title_en: Tancredi – Rossini opera (Italian, English surtitles)
events.description: Revival of Rossini's heroic melodrama of love and loyalty in medieval Syracuse. In Italian with German and English surtitles.

events.title: 2. Sinfoniekonzert: Vom Schatten zum Licht
events.title_en: 2nd Symphony Concert: From Shadow to Light (Shostakovich 5)
events.description: The Philharmonisches Staatsorchester Mainz plays Pancho Vladigerov's Violin Concerto No. 2 (German premiere, soloist concertmaster Mihail Katev) and Shostakovich's Symphony No. 5. Intro at 19:00.

events.title: Refuge (UA) – Deirdre Kinahan
events.title_en: Refuge – new Irish play, performed in English with German surtitles
events.description: World premiere of a play by leading Irish playwright Deirdre Kinahan about 18th-century Palatine settlers in Limerick and today's displaced people. Performed in English with German surtitles.

events.title: 2. Sinfoniekonzert (Museumskonzert): Mahler – Auferstehungssinfonie
events.title_en: Frankfurt Opera & Museum Orchestra: Mahler Symphony No. 2 'Resurrection'
events.description: Thomas Guggeis conducts the Frankfurter Opern- und Museumsorchester, Frankfurt's combined choirs, Nombulelo Yende (soprano) and Zanda Švēde (mezzo) in Mahler's monumental 'Resurrection' Symphony.

events.title: Die Piraten von Penzance (Gilbert & Sullivan)
events.title_en: The Pirates of Penzance – Gilbert & Sullivan operetta
events.description: The very British comic operetta by Gilbert & Sullivan; 8 Nov is the final performance.

events.title: Lieder-Soiree
events.title_en: Song recital evening in the foyer
events.description: Intimate art-song evening with singers of the Wiesbaden opera ensemble in the theatre's foyer; a drink is included in the ticket.

events.title: Mittagskonzert: Dominik Wagner Kontrabassquartett
events.title_en: Lunch concert: Dominik Wagner Double Bass Quartet
events.description: Lunchtime concert by four double basses: Bruckner and Schubert arrangements next to Bohemian Rhapsody and The Final Countdown.

events.title: Junges Konzert: Titan (hr-Sinfonieorchester)
events.title_en: Young Concert: Mahler 'Titan' with the Frankfurt Radio Symphony
events.description: Susanna Mälkki conducts the hr-Sinfonieorchester (Frankfurt Radio Symphony) in Mahler's Symphony No. 1 'Titan' – the season's first 'Young Concert', flat price.

events.title: hr-Sinfonieorchester: Mahler 1 – Große Reihe
events.title_en: Frankfurt Radio Symphony: Mahler Symphony No. 1 & Saariaho
events.description: Susanna Mälkki conducts the Frankfurt Radio Symphony in Kaija Saariaho's trumpet concerto HUSH (soloist Verneri Pohjola) and Mahler's First Symphony.

events.title: Mitten im Klang: Prokofjew – Romeo und Julia
events.title_en: 'In the Middle of the Sound': Prokofiev's Romeo and Juliet (after-work concert)
events.description: Relaxed after-work concert where you sit right among the musicians of the Hessisches Staatsorchester (free seating) while GMD Leo McFall conducts Prokofiev's Romeo and Juliet suites.

events.title: Kakadu Session – Open Stage Live Music
events.title_en: Kakadu Session – open-stage live music night
events.description: Open-stage live music in the theatre's bar – a relaxed place to meet locals. Free entry with admission cards at the door.

events.title: DVOŘÁK IN NEW YORK – Benefizkonzert für die Alte Oper
events.title_en: Dvořák in New York – benefit concert ('New World' Symphony)
events.description: Benefit concert: the FREUNDE-Orchester with Cäcilienchor Frankfurt and Heidelberger Bachchor perform Dvořák's Te Deum and 'New World' Symphony, plus a movement of the 'American' Quartet.

events.title: Der zerbrochne Krug (with English supertitles)
events.title_en: The Broken Jug – Kleist comedy with English surtitles
events.description: Kleist's classic courtroom comedy about a village judge who must try his own crime – shown with English supertitles, a good way into German theatre.

events.title: Karibische Klangwelten – Musiken der Welt
events.title_en: Caribbean Soundworlds – world music
events.description: World-music evening: Afro-Venezuelan rhythms, Barlovento rites, Spanish colonial baroque music and Latin folk.

events.title: Sächsische Staatskapelle Dresden – Daniele Gatti & Augustin Hadelich
events.title_en: Dresden Staatskapelle: Beethoven Violin Concerto & Brahms 2
events.description: One of the world's oldest orchestras under Daniele Gatti: Beethoven's Violin Concerto with Augustin Hadelich and Brahms's Symphony No. 2. Free pre-concert seminar at 18:30.

events.title: Kakadu Kneipenchor – Mitsingen!
events.title_en: Pub choir – sing along!
events.description: Drop-in pub choir in the theatre bar: no experience needed, just come and sing along with everyone.

events.title: Sibelius' Seelenbeichte – Quick & Classy
events.title_en: Sibelius's Confession – 'Quick & Classy' after-work concert
events.description: Short after-work format: Aivis Greters conducts Schumann's Cello Concerto (Anton Spronk) and Sibelius's Symphony No. 2.

events.title: MAGNIFICAT & The Rite of Spring (Marie Chouinard)
events.title_en: Dance: Bach's Magnificat & Stravinsky's Rite of Spring
events.description: Canadian choreographer Marie Chouinard pairs Bach's Magnificat and Stravinsky's Rite of Spring in a double bill – dance with no language barrier.

events.title: Tanztag Rhein-Main 2026
events.title_en: Rhine-Main Dance Day
events.venue: Hessisches Staatstheater & venues across the region
events.description: Region-wide day of dance with performances, open classes and workshops at venues in Wiesbaden, Darmstadt, Frankfurt, Hanau and more. Pay what you want, no registration needed (limited places).

events.title: Staatsorchester meets ... HALLOWEEN
events.title_en: State Orchestra meets Halloween – spooky concert + party
events.description: Saint-Saëns' Danse macabre, HK Gruber's Frankenstein!, and Herrmann's Psycho and Vertigo suites with poetry-slam texts – followed by a Halloween get-together with DJ and bar in the Glashaus.

events.title: Debüt: Petar Pejčić, Violoncello
events.title_en: Debut recital: cellist Petar Pejčić
events.description: Afternoon debut recital by young cellist Petar Pejčić in the Alte Oper's 'Debüt' series.

events.title: Staatskapelle Berlin – Christian Thielemann
events.title_en: Berlin Staatskapelle & Thielemann: Strauss Alpine Symphony
events.description: All-Strauss programme: Christian Thielemann conducts the Staatskapelle Berlin in the Four Last Songs (soprano Camilla Nylund) and the Alpine Symphony.

events.title: Mendelssohns Geniestreich – Kammermusik der Orchesterakademie
events.title_en: Mendelssohn's Stroke of Genius – academy chamber concert
events.description: The hr-Sinfonieorchester's orchestra academy plays chamber music by Farrenc, Borodin, de Falla, Yun, Ligeti and Mendelssohn.

events.title: Tosca (Puccini)
events.title_en: Tosca – opera by Puccini
events.description: Puccini's political thriller-opera in three acts, with the Hessisches Staatsorchester in the pit.

events.title: Liederabend: Kelsey Lauritano (Mezzosopran) / Alden Gatt (Klavier)
events.title_en: Song recital: mezzo-soprano Kelsey Lauritano
events.description: Ensemble member Kelsey Lauritano, acclaimed as Dorabella and Cherubino, gives an intimate song recital with pianist Alden Gatt.

events.title: Panorama Ciego – Forum N
events.title_en: Panorama Ciego – contemporary music
events.description: New-music evening with percussionist Christoph Sietzen: a world-premiere percussion concerto by Bernd Richard Deutsch plus Zimmermann, Mundry and Ammann.

events.title: Nachtträume (Hessisches Staatsballett)
events.title_en: Night Dreams – ballet
events.description: Evening-length dance production by the Hessisches Staatsballett on the main stage.

events.title: 2. Kammerkonzert in der Synagoge
events.title_en: 2nd Chamber Concert in the Synagogue – Remembering the November Pogroms
events.description: Chamber concert by members of the Staatsorchester Mainz in commemoration of the November pogroms of 1938. Free admission.

events.title: Le roi Arthus (Chausson) – Premiere
events.title_en: King Arthur – Chausson opera, Frankfurt premiere (French, English surtitles)
events.description: First Frankfurt staging of Ernest Chausson's Wagner-tinged Arthurian opera, conducted by GMD Thomas Guggeis. In French with German and English surtitles.

events.title: Freiburger Barockorchester – Mozart & Bach
events.title_en: Freiburg Baroque Orchestra: Mozart & Bach
events.description: Kristian Bezuidenhout directs the Freiburg Baroque Orchestra from the fortepiano: Mozart's Piano Concerto No. 12, the C-minor Serenade and Bach.

events.title: 3. Sinfoniekonzert: Spanische Nacht
events.title_en: 3rd Symphony Concert: Spanish Night
events.description: French composers in love with Spain: Debussy's 'Ibéria', Lalo's Cello Concerto with Maximilian Hornung, music by Josephine Stephenson and Ravel's Boléro, conducted by Geoffrey Paterson. Pre-concert talk 18:45.

events.title: Lukas Sternath, Klavier
events.title_en: Piano recital: Lukas Sternath
events.description: ARD Competition winner Lukas Sternath plays Schubert's 'Wanderer' Fantasy, Schubert/Liszt songs and Liszt's Années de pèlerinage (Italie).

events.title: hr-Sinfonieorchester: All'ungherese – Große Reihe
events.title_en: Frankfurt Radio Symphony: Brahms Piano Concerto 2 & Bartók
events.description: Elim Chan conducts the Frankfurt Radio Symphony with pianist Beatrice Rana: Brahms's Piano Concerto No. 2 and Bartók's Concerto for Orchestra.

events.title: Hänsel und Gretel (Humperdinck)
events.title_en: Hansel and Gretel – Humperdinck opera (English surtitles)
events.description: Seasonal revival of Humperdinck's fairy-tale opera, a pre-Christmas classic. German with German and English surtitles.

events.title: 3. Sinfoniekonzert: Energy Concert
events.title_en: 3rd Symphony Concert: 'Energy Concert' – Gershwin, Milhaud, Kapustin
events.description: Jazz meets orchestra: Milhaud's 'La Création du monde', Kapustin's Piano Concerto No. 5, Rudi Stephan's 'Musik für Orchester' and Gershwin's Rhapsody in Blue in the original jazz-band version.

events.title: Concertgebouworkest – Klaus Mäkelä: Mahler 7
events.title_en: Royal Concertgebouw Orchestra & Mäkelä: Mahler Symphony No. 7
events.description: The Royal Concertgebouw Orchestra with its chief-designate Klaus Mäkelä in Mahler's colourful Symphony No. 7. Free pre-concert seminar at 18:30.

events.title: 3. Sinfoniekonzert (Museumskonzert): Wege zu Bruckner
events.title_en: Frankfurt Opera & Museum Orchestra: Paths to Bruckner (Symphony No. 4 'Romantic')
events.description: Thomas Guggeis and soprano Anna Prohaska trace a line from Hildegard von Bingen, Bach (orch. Webern), Mozart and Schubert to Bruckner's 'Romantic' Fourth Symphony.

events.title: Frauen im Fokus – Kammerflimmern
events.title_en: Women in Focus – string quartets
events.address: Internationales Theater Frankfurt, Frankfurt am Main
events.description: Relaxed late chamber concert by hr-Sinfonieorchester string players: quartets by Grażyna Bacewicz, Emilie Mayer and Beethoven.

events.title: Wassermusik – Barock+
events.title_en: Water Music – baroque concert
events.description: Jean-Christophe Spinosi conducts baroque concertos by Vivaldi and Telemann and excerpts from Handel's Water Music.

events.title: Behind the Scenes + Branford Marsalis & Dianne Reeves celebrate John Coltrane
events.description: Grammy winners Branford Marsalis (with his quartet) and Dianne Reeves celebrate Coltrane's 100th birthday. Preceded at 19:00 by the English-language 'Behind the Scenes' talk for international guests, with a jazz chill-out afterwards.

events.title: 3. Kammerkonzert: Cello a quattro
events.title_en: 3rd Chamber Concert: Four Cellos
events.description: Sunday matinee of chamber music for cello quartet played by musicians of the Hessisches Staatsorchester in the theatre foyer.

events.title: Blechpartie – Frankfurt Radio Brass
events.title_en: Brass Party – brass quintet
events.description: Brass quintet of the hr-Sinfonieorchester: Bach's Toccata and Fugue in D minor arranged for brass, Schwertsik, Kerry Turner and Crespo's Suite Americana.

events.title: Orchestre des Champs-Élysées
events.description: The French period-instrument orchestra in the Alte Oper's great hall; also bookable as a package with an afternoon programme at the German Architecture Museum.

events.title: Coriolan – Auftakt (Beethoven 200)
events.title_en: Coriolan – Beethoven 7 & Sibelius Violin Concerto
events.description: Eva Ollikainen conducts Beethoven's Coriolan Overture and Seventh Symphony and Sibelius's Violin Concerto with Clara-Jumi Kang.

events.title: La Bohème (Puccini) – Premiere
events.title_en: La Bohème – opera by Puccini (premiere of new production)
events.description: Premiere of a new Bohème staged by Götz-Friedrich-Prize winner Aileen Schneider: young artists in poverty, creativity and love. Premiere party afterwards.

events.title: 80 Jahre Hessen: Side by Side
events.title_en: 80 Years of Hesse: Frankfurt Radio Symphony & youth orchestra side by side
events.description: The hr-Sinfonieorchester plays side by side with the Hesse State Youth Symphony Orchestra: Beethoven's Coriolan and Symphony No. 7, Sibelius's Violin Concerto (Clara-Jumi Kang), conductor Eva Ollikainen.

events.title: Titanic – The Musical (Premiere)
events.title_en: Titanic – The Musical (premiere)
events.description: Premiere of Maury Yeston and Peter Stone's Tony-winning musical about the maiden voyage of the Titanic.

events.title: Bach, Weihnachtsoratorium
events.title_en: Bach: Christmas Oratorio
events.description: Bach's Christmas Oratorio in the Alte Oper's great hall.
